title: Japan Just Lapped South Korea In Tourism
source: Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO) inbound visitor totals: 2019 31.88M (pre-pandemic peak), 2020 4.12M, 2021 0.25M (COVID low), 2022 3.83M, 2023 25.07M, 2024 36.87M (record, per JNTO/Reuters coverage). Korea Tourism Organization inbound totals: 2019 17.50M, 2020 2.5M, 2021 0.97M, 2022 3.20M, 2023 11.03M, 2024 16.36M (still below its own 2019 peak). Both countries crashed together in 2020-2021; Japan's recovery pulled dramatically ahead of Korea's by 2023-2024, widely reported as Japan riding a weak yen to record visitor numbers.
